name: Raffles Dubai

address.street: Wafi - Sheikh Rashid Rd - Umm Hurair 2 - Dubai - United Arab Emirates

insider_take: This pyramid-shaped architectural marvel stands as Dubai's most distinctive luxury landmark, where ancient Egyptian grandeur meets ultra-modern opulence in the heart of Wafi City.
whats_special: Raffles Dubai's striking pyramid design houses just 252 suites, making it one of the city's most exclusive properties. The hotel features authentic Egyptian-themed interiors with hand-carved pharaonic artifacts, while its rooftop Fire & Ice restaurant offers 360-degree views of Dubai's skyline. The property sits within the unique Wafi complex, designed to resemble an ancient Egyptian palace.
pro_tip: Book a suite on the upper floors for unobstructed views of the Burj Khalifa and Dubai Creek, and don't miss the complimentary access to the stunning rooftop pool deck during sunset hours.
dont_miss: The hotel's direct connection to Khan Murjan Souk, one of the region's most atmospheric traditional markets featuring over 150 shops selling authentic Middle Eastern goods. Also explore the adjacent Wafi Mall's pharaonic architecture and the nearby Dubai Creek for traditional dhow cruises just minutes away.
pros: Iconic pyramid-shaped architecture creating a distinctive landmark presence
Prime location in Dubai's Business Bay with stunning city skyline views
Legendary Raffles butler service providing personalized luxury experience
Spacious suites with panoramic floor-to-ceiling windows
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflecting ultra-high-end positioning
Formal atmosphere may not suit casual travelers
